Alternatively, studies that equated volume between heavy- and medium-load training have failed to demonstrate superiority for the hypertrophy range (39, 47). Taken collectively, the findings suggest that volume, as opposed to intensity of load, was responsible for any observed differences in muscle growth. All of the aforementioned studies used untrained subjects, limiting the ability to generalize findings to trained lifters.
